instructions: 0sql plans SQL from a semantic model; it never runs it. Every tool but list_projects takes a project uid and a branch; the branch defaults to the project's production branch. When you were told the project and branch, pass them and skip list_projects: a uid the key cannot read is refused by name, so trying costs no more than listing. Discovery is one call: fields with no q returns the branch's whole catalogue as text, every measure with uid, type, description and synonyms by table and every dimension with its uid by table. Write the spec from it and go straight to sql; fields with q searches one phrase, for the rare term the catalogue does not settle. Several fields share a word; the top score is only the closest wording. The extra words in a name and the table a field is on say which thing it describes, so a same-worded field on another table is a different thing, never a substitute. Where the request qualifies an attribute (whose, which role or event, now versus as of the row) take the candidate whose name or table carries that qualifier; where it qualifies nothing, take the plain one. Put the chosen uid in the spec: names and synonyms are shared and a near miss is corrected silently. sql takes a query spec and returns the statement to run against the named datasource; it refuses a spec it cannot plan and says why. Who the query is planned for is fixed by the key, not by you. The catalogue of the branches this key may read follows; a client that cuts it short gets all of it from fields.

tools.list_projects: The deployed branches this key may read, with the size of each model, and the projects of the account.
tools.fields: Without q: the whole catalogue of the branch as text, every field with its uid, grouped by table, in one call. With q: the fields containing or near the text, each with its uid, data type, description, synonyms, tags and tables, best first with a score.
tools.tables: The tables of a branch: physical name, datasource, cost and the fields on each.
tools.values: The sampled values of one dimension, when the project uploaded samples. A branch whose summary in list_projects shows values 0 has none, and the call answers NotFound; filter values then come from the question or the field's description.
tools.explore: Given a query spec, the dimensions and measures that can still be added to it, narrowed by q.
tools.sql: The SQL for a query spec, and the datasource and adapter it is for. Run it yourself; this server does not.
tools.explain: The SQL for a query spec with how it was planned: timings, phases and the node graph.
